notes: Denmark storefront (da-dk locale, SFCC, direct HTTP fetch worked throughout - no Playwright/CiC needed). Per assignment hint, Danish 'Nyheder'/'Nyt' = New Arrivals; confirmed real. The site nests a genuine 'Nyheder' PLP under each of its 4 shopping departments (all present in sitemap AND main nav, page titles literally 'new products/new designs' in Danish): /da-dk/bolig/nyheder (Home), /da-dk/til-bordet/nyheder (Table/Dining), /da-dk/smykker/nyheder (Jewellery), /da-dk/soelvhaandvaerk/nyheder (Silverware). There is also an un-navlinked but fully live, sitemap-absent-but-directly-reachable aggregate page /da-dk/nyheder (title 'Se alle de nye produkter og kollektioner' = 'See all new products and collections') whose product set is essentially the union of the 4 department pages (179 unique tiles vs 172 in the union of the 4, 171/172 overlapping) - treated as the parent/aggregate row. A near-duplicate URL /da-dk/nyheder/smykker also exists (86 tiles, 81/82 overlap with /da-dk/smykker/nyheder) - treated as an alias of the same underlying Jewellery listing, canonical /da-dk/smykker/nyheder kept (matches the site's consistent <dept>/nyheder URL pattern and is the one indexed in the sitemap). The sitemap also lists /da-dk/jul/nyheder (Christmas New Arrivals, page title dated 'Julekollektion 2025' but the live product grid was independently tile-counted at 64 items matching current inventory) - included as a genuine site-taxonomy child since the brief does not scope this project away from holiday/gift content the way the separate Home-Decor project did; flagged for a human policy check given that other passes in this same multi-project pipeline exclude Christmas/Gift content by convention. All qty values are exhaustive unique data-itemid tile counts from the search-result-items grid (explicitly excluding the separate plp-recommendations-carousel Einstein block) on a single ?start=0&sz=200 (sz=300 for the aggregate) fetch, since this SFCC site does not server-render its 'Viser N af N' results-count text (it is populated client-side by JS and was empty/absent in every plain HTTP fetch, confirmed against a known category page too) - same exhaustive-tile-count method used by the prior Home-Decor pass on this same company. Checked and excluded as non-qualifying: '/da-dk/bolig/design-icons' and similar curated 'featured' collections do not use New/Nyheder naming and were not investigated further (out of scope - no New Arrivals signal). No 'New Collection'-style ambiguous pages were found requiring the Collection-page ambiguity flag.
